entries.title: Joshua 20:1
segments: ¶The LORD also spoke to Joshua, saying,

entries.title: Joshua 20:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: 'Appoint for yourselves cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Moses,

entries.title: Joshua 20:3
segments: 'that the slayer who kills a person accidentally [or] unintentionally may flee there; and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

entries.title: Joshua 20:4
segments: 'And when he flees to one of those cities, and stands at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declares his case in the hearing of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city as one of them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

entries.title: Joshua 20:5
segments: 'Then if the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not deliver the slayer into his hand, because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, but did not hate him beforehand.

entries.title: Joshua 20:6
segments: 'And he shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, [and] until the death of the one who is high priest in those days. Then the slayer may return and come to his own city and his own house, to the city from which he fled.'"

entries.title: Joshua 20:7
segments: ¶So they appointed Kedesh in Galilee, in the mountains of Naphtali, Shechem in the mountains of Ephraim, and Kirjath Arba (which [is] Hebron) in the mountains of Judah.

entries.title: Joshua 20:8
segments: And on the other side of the Jordan, by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness on the plain, from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.

entries.title: Joshua 20:9
segments: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel and for the stranger who dwelt among them, that whoever killed a person accidentally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stood before the congregation.
